components.name: badge
components.description: Small labels for status and metadata. Status badges always carry a word.

components.name: button
components.description: Triggers an action or navigates. Five variants, three sizes, an icon slot and a Livewire loading state.

components.name: card
components.description: Groups related content and actions in a bordered surface, with header, title, description, content and footer parts.

components.name: icon
components.description: Renders an icon by its Velyx name from the icon set chosen at init. Generated from registry/icons/icons.json.

components.name: input
components.description: A single-line text field. Reads errors from the Laravel error bag and sets aria-invalid.

components.name: label
components.description: An accessible label with an optional required mark and hint.
